label: Figure 10.4(b): TR when PED = infinity
alt: Total revenue is an upward-sloping straight line through the origin, reaching $40 at 5 units, with slope equal to the constant price of $8.
caption: When demand is perfectly elastic at a price of $8, TR = 8 × q is a straight line through the origin (for example $40 at 5 units). Each extra unit adds a constant $8, so MR = $8 and equals the slope of TR.
